ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 65%) with significant mid-intensity tan/yellow staining (approx. 25%) and low-intensity black pigmentation (approx. 10%) localized at the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous high-intensity white zones in the upper-central lobes. Irregular, large-scale tan/yellow mottling clustered at the lower-central region and extending laterally. A distinct low-intensity black band follows the trailing edge perimeter, widening at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; pixel amplitude of peaks ranges from 8 to 20 pixels, with the most pronounced and jagged variations occurring on the outer lateral halves of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible clusters of high-intensity, textured white pixels at both distal tips indicating active barnacle colonization; several small semi-circular indentations (tissue loss) along the trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, diffuse tan/yellow biological staining covering the lower-central junction and spreading into both lobes, creating a distinct three-tone color gradient.
